labels_math_and_numbers.evidence: The values 18-field, 6-axis, 138-source, 50+, and 123 are preserved. connections_and_direction.evidence: Downward preprocessing and construction sequences and the two-way authoring/coverage cycle remain. Dotted dependencies retain their endpoints: blueprint to experts, source map to reference package, questions to scope review, reference package to cross-validation, and atomic rubrics to rubric audit. Quality-control steps remain ordered 1–6, with the blue terminal connector leading to the database.

visual_encodings.evidence: Numbered blue circles still encode stage/order; taxonomy dots and checkmarks retain their colors and positions; alternating quality-control fills and rubric grouping remain consistent. The added solid/dotted-arrow legend describes the existing within-stage flow and cross-stage dependencies without changing their meanings.

examples_and_data.evidence: The illustrative taxonomy matrix, three-bar coverage graphic, financial scenario, and six-category source map are retained. No new measurements, example questions, outcomes, or category identities are introduced.

unsupported_additions.evidence: Added connector labels—Coverage guidance, Source guidance, Questions, Reference package, and Atomic criteria—describe relationships already depicted and supported by the supplied construction text. The arrow legend adds an explanation, not a new method component or result.

complete_visible_content.evidence: The full derivative contains all three stages, the complete quality-control descriptions, source-map annotations, final database, and 123 Verified Questions label. remaining_limitations: Assessment uses the supplied full images, detail crops, and source text. Figure 1: Overview of FINFIRST construction pipeline: Data Preprocessing derives a taxonomy,
coverage blueprint, and source map from real-world financial scenarios; Data Construction engages
over 50 finance experts to iteratively author tasks, balance coverage, construct evidence-grounded ref-
erence packages, and define atomic rubrics; and Quality Control applies a 6-stage filtering procedure,
yielding a final set of 123 verified questions.
delegated_acceptance_review: Reviewed final image and independent eight-check response: three construction stages, 50+ experts, 18-field/6-axis/138-source labels, all six QC cards, five cross-stage dependencies and terminal 123-question database remain. Recomputed all protected-region transformations including connector boundary pixels.
